duration.text: The Transport Economics and Management at Shanghai Maritime University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4027 USD/per year ￥ 29000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 7.Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 8.Statement of purpose Around 1500 words for PhD candidates, including the study and work experience, academic research result, planned research proposal, and individual development objective after graduation.
